CheckVersion.description: Schema tag of an archive report, `crn-craft.archive-check/1.0`.

Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

Termination.description:
How a replicate, or the whole ensemble, ended.

Values are ordered by severity, from `completed` to `output_limit`. The ensemble reports `completed` when every replicate completed or stopped, and otherwise the most severe replicate termination.

oneOf.description: The model's stop condition held, ATP was depleted under thinning, a continuous variable reached its lower bound with `on_bound: "stop"` under hybrid, or an observer stopped the replicate; the state is held to the end of the grid.

description: Report of writing or verifying a `crn-craft.archive/1.0` archive: archive integrity and the outcome of the archived run.

archive_complete.description: True when every file, the manifest and the completion marker are present and consistent. It says nothing about whether the run finished.

diagnostics.description: Why the archive is invalid; empty for a valid archive.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archived model bytes; null when the archive is invalid.

result.description: The archived result's `schema`, for example `crn-craft.result/1.0` or `crn-craft.fsp-result/1.0`; null when the archive is invalid.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archived request bytes; null when the archive is invalid.

simulation_complete.description: True when the archived result is complete: a simulation result whose termination is `completed`, or a finite state projection.

termination.description: The archived simulation result's ensemble termination; null for a finite state projection and when the archive is invalid.

valid.description: True when the archive was written, or verified, without error.

title: ArchiveReport
